text: This report provides information and identifies a preliminary set of issues regarding the Official Plan Amendment and Zoning By-law Amendment applications for a 12-storey (36.5 metre) residential building, containing 301 dwelling units which will result in a gross floor area (GFA) of 19,085 square metres and a density of 5.26 times the area of the lot. The applications have been circulated to all appropriate City divisions and public agencies for comment. Substantial revisions are required to the proposed development to address a number of matters raised in this report, including but not limited to suitability of the site size to accommodate the proposed building, and setbacks and separation distances consistent with the Tall Building Guidelines.
